mcs.circular_three_series_exact_match.spec: of the same 3-series subset, how many now have an IDENTICAL surviving model set (not just equal cardinality) to arch's own, when OUR bootstrap uses a fixed-length circular resampling scheme instead of moving-block (moving-block: 1 of 3) -- the exact-set-identity check mcs_robustness.py::arch_cross_check_full() already applies to the full 12-series panel, extended here to this file's own block-structure comparison

mcs.circular_three_series_match.spec: cardinality-only match on a 3-series subset (NOT the same check as S4.1's own arch cross-check, which runs on all 12 curated series -- see mcsarch.curated_exact_match and mcs_robustness.py's arch_cross_check_full()): how many of 3 series match arch's |MCS| cardinality exactly under circular resampling (moving-block matches 1 of 3). See mcs.circular_three_series_exact_match for the stronger, surviving-set-identity version of this same comparison

mcs.curated_nonidentified_circular.spec: mean non-identified count on the curated panel at the default configuration (block=3, B=2000, alpha=0.10) over a 10-seed band (this file's own seeds=range(10) default -- NOT the same band as S4.1's 50-seed Monte-Carlo band), with circular=True instead of moving-block resampling (moving-block mean over the identical seeds: 11.0)

mcssize.arch_gap_circular.spec: the same gap to the published arch figure, with circular resampling instead of moving-block -- narrower but not closed. NOTE: both this gap and mcssize.arch_gap_moving_block compare our scheme against arch's STATIONARY-bootstrap default, and against an arch rate measured on a different panel draw; the like-for-like gaps are mcssize.arch_gap_matched_*

mcssize.arch_gap_matched_circular.spec: |our circular size - arch's size| when arch is ALSO run with a circular block bootstrap (bootstrap='circular'), on the identical null panels -- the like-for-like gap for the circular scheme

mcssize.arch_gap_matched_moving_block.spec: |our moving-block size - arch's size| when arch is ALSO run with a moving-block bootstrap (bootstrap='moving block'), on the identical 2000 null panels, K=6, T=30, block=3, B=800, alpha=0.10: the like-for-like implementation gap with the resampling scheme held fixed

mcssize.arch_gap_moving_block.spec: gap between the published arch figure (mcssize.size_arch) and our moving-block size (mcssize.size_at_nominal_10) -- the discrepancy S4.2's prose names before testing whether the bootstrap scheme explains it

mcssize.size_circular.spec: empirical rejection rate on exactly-null panels at K=6, T=30, block=3, alpha=0.10, with circular=True instead of the default moving-block scheme -- the same measurement mcssize.size_at_nominal_10 makes, with only the resampling scheme changed
